# Adaptive Execution {#plan-ch12}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Explains how a policy should respond when forecasts, market conditions, or beliefs change during an order.

**Subtopics.** Feedback policies; state and belief updates; receding-horizon control; model-predictive control; Bayesian learning; uncertain parameters; robust and distributionally robust optimization; dual control; changing volume, volatility, spread, and alpha; stability; excessive switching; hysteresis; guardrails; emergency completion; value of adaptation.
